title: FlagPointers
description: Converts Hypixel lobby compasses to flags based on selected languages
body:
**FlagPointers** transforms the compasses held by players in Hypixel lobbies into flags representing their chosen language on Hypixel.

## Language Support
FlagPointers supports these following mods:
- Korean
- English
- Russian
- German
- Spanish
- Greek
- French
- Swedish
- Dutch
- Czech
- Polish
- Romanian
- Finnish
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Norwegian
- Simplified Chinese
- Portuguese
- Hungarian
- Traditional Chinese
- Danish
- Japanese
- "Pirate Speak" _(Minecraft joke language)_
- Turkish
- Italian
- Ukrainian

## Use Cases
- Find Like-Minded Players: Easily connect with others who share your language for seamless gameplay.
- Discover Your Friends' Languages: Curious about the languages your Hypixel friends speak? Warp them into a lobby, and have them hold their compass to find out!
